scenarios.name: 租房咨询
scenarios.desc: Section 1 最常见的场景之一。考生打电话给中介或房东，询问房型、租金、押金、可入住日期、是否带家具、账单是否包含等。这类题几乎必考「数字 + 拼写」：金额、日期、门牌号、姓名、街道名。听的时候要特别留意说话人重复或纠正的那一次，答案往往在纠正之后。

scenarios.name: 图书馆
scenarios.desc: 常见于 Section 1（办理借书证）或 Section 2（图书馆导览）。高频信息包括开放时间、可借数量、借期、续借方式、逾期罚款金额、各楼层分区、研讨室预约规则。注意「楼层」的表达（ground floor / first floor）在英式英语中容易造成理解偏差：ground floor 是一楼。

vocab.cn: 参考书区（仅限馆内阅览）

scenarios.name: 课程咨询
scenarios.desc: Section 1 或 Section 3 的高频场景。学生致电或面谈咨询课程：开课时间、学制长度、费用与折扣、入学要求、班级人数、考核方式、需要自备的材料。这里最容易失分的是「价格」——通常先报原价，随后给出学生价或早报名优惠，题目问的往往是最终要付的金额。

scenarios.name: 旅游行程
scenarios.desc: Section 1（电话预订）或 Section 2（景点介绍）都很常见。核心信息：行程安排、出发与返回时间、集合地点、费用包含与不包含的项目、住宿类型、取消政策。要特别注意「包含 / 不包含」的表述，如 it's included / that's extra / you'll need to pay separately，这类信息几乎一定会出题。

scenarios.name: 学术讲座
scenarios.desc: Section 4 的标准形态：一位讲师独白，讲一个学术话题，没有停顿也没有重复。语言特征是高密度名词化、逻辑连接词明显（first, a second factor, by contrast, as a result）。做题关键不是听懂每个词，而是抓住「序号词 + 转折词 + 结论句」，因为答案几乎都落在这些位置附近。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Good morning, Riverside Lettings, Daniel speaking. How can I help?
sentences.zh: 早上好，这里是河畔房产，我是丹尼尔。有什么可以帮您？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Hello, I'm calling about the two-bedroom flat advertised on Mill Road. Is it still available?
sentences.zh: 你好，我打电话是想问一下米尔路广告上那套两居室，现在还空着吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: It is, yes. We've had a couple of viewings but no applications yet. Are you looking to move in soon?
sentences.zh: 还空着。我们已经带人看过两次，但还没有人申请。您是打算尽快入住吗？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Fairly soon — my current contract ends on the thirtieth of September, so ideally the first of October.
sentences.zh: 比较快——我现在的合同九月三十号到期，所以最好是十月一号入住。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: That works. The flat is vacant from the twenty-first, so the dates aren't a problem. Can I take a few details?
sentences.zh: 没问题。房子从二十一号起就空出来了，所以时间上不冲突。我可以记一些信息吗？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Of course. My name's Elena Marsh — that's M-A-R-S-H.
sentences.zh: 当然。我叫埃琳娜·马什，拼写是 M-A-R-S-H。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Thank you. Is this for yourself alone, or will someone be moving in with you?
sentences.zh: 谢谢。是您一个人住，还是有人和您一起搬进来？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: My sister. She's starting a nursing course at the hospital in October, so we'd both be on the tenancy.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹。她十月份要在医院开始读护理课程，所以我们两个人都会在租约上。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Fine. The rent is seven hundred and eighty pounds a month, and that covers water but not electricity or broadband.
sentences.zh: 好的。租金是每月七百八十英镑，包含水费，但不含电费和宽带。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: And how much is the deposit?
sentences.zh: 那押金是多少？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Four weeks' rent, which comes to seven hundred and twenty pounds. It's held in a government-approved scheme and returned within ten days of moving out, as long as there's no damage.
sentences.zh: 四周租金，也就是七百二十英镑。押金存放在政府认可的托管机构，只要房屋没有损坏，搬出后十天内退还。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: That's reasonable. Is there a minimum length of tenancy?
sentences.zh: 还算合理。有最短租期吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Twelve months, and after that it continues on a month-by-month basis.
sentences.zh: 十二个月，之后按月续租。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Does the flat come furnished?
sentences.zh: 房子带家具吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Partly. There's a bed, a wardrobe and a sofa, but no desk, and there's no washing machine in the flat itself — though there is a laundry room in the basement.
sentences.zh: 部分带。有一张床、一个衣柜和一张沙发，但没有书桌，屋内也没有洗衣机——不过地下室有洗衣房。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: One more thing — is parking included?
sentences.zh: 还有一件事——包含停车位吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: There's no allocated space, but residents can apply to the council for a permit, which is about ninety pounds a year.
sentences.zh: 没有固定车位，但住户可以向市政厅申请停车许可，一年大约九十英镑。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: That's fine, we don't have a car anyway. Could I arrange a viewing?
sentences.zh: 没关系，我们本来也没有车。可以约看房吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Of course. I could do Thursday at four, or Friday morning at ten.
sentences.zh: 当然。我可以安排周四下午四点，或者周五上午十点。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Friday at ten is better for me. I finish work at five on Thursdays, so four o'clock is too early.
sentences.zh: 周五十点对我更合适。我周四五点才下班，所以四点太早了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Friday at ten it is. I'll email you the address and the reference number this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那就周五十点。我今天下午把地址和房源编号发邮件给您。

questions.question: Why is the woman calling?
options: A. To complain about a repair that has not been done
B. To ask about a flat she saw advertised
C. To cancel an existing tenancy agreement
D. To apply for a parking permit
questions.explanation: 第二句 I'm calling about the two-bedroom flat advertised on Mill Road 直接给出目的。C 是干扰项：她只是提到现有合同到期，并不是要取消。

questions.question: When does the woman's current contract end?
questions.explanation: my current contract ends on the thirtieth of September。10 月 1 日是她希望入住的日期（ideally），不是合同到期日，这是典型的日期干扰。

questions.question: What does the rent include?
questions.explanation: that covers water but not electricity or broadband。注意 but not 之后的内容是被排除的，停车另需向市政厅申请许可并付费。

questions.question: What is NOT provided in the flat?
questions.explanation: there's no washing machine in the flat itself，只有地下室有洗衣房。题干用 NOT provided 反向提问，需要把 no 转换成否定项。

questions.question: When will the viewing take place?
questions.explanation: 中介先提议周四四点，女方因为五点才下班而拒绝，最后确定 Friday at ten。凡是出现两个时间选项的题，答案几乎都在后一个。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Good afternoon, Westbridge Adult Education Centre. Claire speaking.
sentences.zh: 下午好，这里是西桥成人教育中心，我是克莱尔。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Hi, I'm interested in the evening photography course that starts next month. Are there still places?
sentences.zh: 你好，我对下个月开课的晚间摄影课感兴趣。还有名额吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: There are, but not many. The Tuesday group is almost full; the Thursday group still has about six spaces.
sentences.zh: 还有，但不多了。周二班基本满了，周四班还有六个左右的名额。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Thursday suits me better anyway. How long does the course run?
sentences.zh: 周四本来就更适合我。这门课要上多久？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Ten weeks, with a two-week break over the holidays, so it finishes in the middle of March.
sentences.zh: 十周，中间放假停两周，所以三月份中旬结束。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: And the fee?
sentences.zh: 费用呢？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Two hundred and forty pounds, or one hundred and ninety if you're a student or over sixty-five.
sentences.zh: 两百四十英镑；如果你是学生或年满六十五岁，则是一百九十英镑。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: I'm a postgraduate, so it would be the lower price. Do I need my own camera?
sentences.zh: 我是研究生，所以适用较低的价格。需要自备相机吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: You need a camera with manual controls, but it doesn't have to be expensive. We keep six cameras to lend out if you'd rather try before buying.
sentences.zh: 需要一台有手动模式的相机，但不必很贵。我们有六台可以外借，如果你想先试用再买的话。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: I've got an old film camera. Would that be acceptable?
sentences.zh: 我有一台老式胶片相机，可以吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: For the first half, yes. But the second half covers digital editing, so you'd need access to a digital camera for those sessions.
sentences.zh: 前半段可以。但后半段讲数码修图，所以那几次课你需要有一台数码相机可用。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: I see. What should I bring to the first session?
sentences.zh: 明白了。第一次课我需要带什么？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Just your camera and one photograph you've taken that you actually like. We spend the first evening looking at everyone's work and talking about what they want from the course.
sentences.zh: 只要带上你的相机，再带一张你自己拍的、你确实喜欢的照片。第一个晚上我们看每个人的作品，聊聊大家想从课程中得到什么。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: That sounds useful. Is there anything else I should know?
sentences.zh: 听起来很有用。还有什么我需要知道的吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Only that there's a small charge for printing, about fifteen pounds for the term, and the darkroom is open on Saturday mornings at no extra cost.
sentences.zh: 只有一点：冲印要收一点费用，一学期大约十五英镑；暗房在周六上午开放，不额外收费。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Good. Can I book a place now?
sentences.zh: 好的。我现在可以预订名额吗？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: You can, but I'll need payment in full to hold the place. I can take a card over the phone if that's easier.
sentences.zh: 可以，但我需要收到全额付款才能为你保留名额。如果方便，我可以在电话里刷信用卡。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: That's fine, let's do that. And could you email me the reading list before the first class?
sentences.zh: 可以，那就这样办吧。另外，你能在第一节课前把阅读书目发邮件给我吗？

questions.question: What is the man enquiring about?
options: C. A camera he wants to buy
questions.explanation: 第二句 the evening photography course that starts next month。A 项把 evening 换成 weekend，是常见的细节偷换。

questions.question: Which group still has places available?
questions.explanation: The Tuesday group is almost full; the Thursday group still has about six spaces。almost full 不等于满，但题目问的是「仍有名额」的那个班，即周四。

questions.question: How much will the man pay for the course?
questions.explanation: 原价 240，学生价 190，男方明确说 I'm a postgraduate, so it would be the lower price。雅思听力里「先报价、后给折扣、再确认」是固定套路，答案为折扣价。

questions.question: What will the man need for the second half of the course?
options: B. Access to a digital camera
D. A laptop with editing software
questions.explanation: the second half covers digital editing, so you'd need access to a digital camera。A 项是前半段的要求，C 项偷换了「冲印收费」的信息。

questions.question: What extra cost is mentioned?
questions.explanation: there's a small charge for printing, about fifteen pounds。暗房是 at no extra cost，借相机也未提收费，两个都是典型的反向干扰。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Good afternoon. Today I want to look at a phenomenon most of you have experienced without necessarily naming it: the urban heat island.
sentences.zh: 下午好。今天我想讲一个你们大多数人都经历过、但未必叫得出名字的现象：城市热岛。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: When a city replaces fields and trees with concrete, asphalt and glass, it changes the way heat is absorbed, stored and released.
sentences.zh: 当城市用混凝土、沥青和玻璃取代田野和树木时，它改变了热量被吸收、储存和释放的方式。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: The effect is normally measured by comparing air temperatures in the city centre with those at a rural site ten or twenty kilometres away.
sentences.zh: 这种效应通常通过比较市中心与十到二十公里外乡村地点的气温来衡量。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: In a large city on a still, clear night, that difference can reach seven degrees Celsius.
sentences.zh: 在一个无风晴朗的夜晚，大城市的温差可以达到七摄氏度。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Notice that I said night. The largest differences appear after sunset, not at midday.
sentences.zh: 请注意我说的是夜晚。最大的温差出现在日落后，而不是正午。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: During the day the two locations are often surprisingly similar, because both receive the same amount of sunlight.
sentences.zh: 白天两地往往惊人地相似，因为两者接收到的日照量相同。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: At night, however, rural ground cools quickly, while the brick and stone of the city go on releasing the heat they absorbed during the day.
sentences.zh: 然而到了夜里，乡村地面迅速降温，而城市的砖石则继续释放白天吸收的热量。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: A second factor is that cities generate heat of their own: vehicles, air conditioning units, factories and, of course, the people walking down the street.
sentences.zh: 第二个因素是城市自身也在产热：车辆、空调外机、工厂，当然还有街上行走的人。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: A third factor is what we call the sky view factor, meaning the proportion of sky that is visible from street level.
sentences.zh: 第三个因素是我们所说的天空可视因子，指的是从街道高度能看到的天空比例。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: A narrow street between tall buildings can radiate heat upwards only through a small opening, so it cools far more slowly than an open square.
sentences.zh: 高楼之间的狭窄街道只能通过一个很小的开口向上散发热量，因此它降温的速度远慢于开阔的广场。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Vegetation is the fourth element, and it cools the air in two distinct ways: it provides shade, and it releases water vapour through its leaves.
sentences.zh: 植被是第四个要素，它通过两种不同的方式给空气降温：提供遮荫，以及通过叶片释放水汽。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: A mature tree can therefore have an effect equivalent to several air conditioning units, and it does so without using any electricity.
sentences.zh: 因此一棵成年树的效果相当于好几台空调，而且它不需要消耗任何电力。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: This matters for public health, and not merely for comfort.
sentences.zh: 这对公共健康很重要，而不只是关乎舒适。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: During a heatwave, the excess deaths recorded in a city are concentrated in the districts with the least green space and the oldest housing.
sentences.zh: 在热浪期间，城市中记录的超额死亡集中在绿地最少、住房最旧的城区。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Unfortunately, these are often the same districts where residents can least afford to install cooling.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这些城区往往也是居民最无力安装降温设备的城区。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Planners have three broad options: they can raise reflectivity by painting roofs white, they can plant trees, and they can redesign streets so that air moves through them.
sentences.zh: 规划者有三类大方向：把屋顶刷成白色以提高反射率、种树，以及重新设计街道让空气流通。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Of these, tree planting is the most popular and the least controversial, but it is also the slowest: a tree needs twenty years to do the work that a new roof coating does immediately.
sentences.zh: 其中种树最受欢迎、争议也最小，但它也最慢：一棵树需要二十年才能完成新屋顶涂层立刻就能做到的事。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: So the practical answer is usually a combination of measures, applied street by street rather than across the whole city at once.
sentences.zh: 所以实际的答案通常是多种措施的组合，逐条街道推行，而不是整座城市一次性铺开。

questions.question: What is the urban heat island effect?
options: A. Cities are warmer than the countryside around them
B. Cities receive more sunlight than rural areas
C. Cities cool down faster than rural areas at night
D. Cities produce more rain than rural areas
questions.explanation: 全篇的核心定义在第二、三句：城市改变了热量的吸收与释放，导致市中心气温高于乡村。C 与原文完全相反（城市降温更慢）。

questions.question: When is the temperature difference greatest?
questions.explanation: The largest differences appear after sunset, not at midday。讲师特意强调 Notice that I said night，这种自我强调在 Section 4 中几乎必然是考点。

questions.question: What does the sky view factor measure?
options: A. The height of the tallest building in an area
B. The proportion of sky visible from street level
C. The number of clear days in a year
D. The reflectivity of roofs and walls
questions.explanation: the proportion of sky that is visible from street level，定义直接给出。D 项是后面「刷白屋顶」提到的反射率，属于概念混淆干扰。

questions.question: Why is tree planting described as a slow solution?
options: A. It is expensive to maintain
B. Residents usually object to it
C. Trees take about twenty years to become effective
D. It requires permission from the council
questions.explanation: a tree needs twenty years to do the work that a new roof coating does immediately。原文没有提到维护成本、居民反对或审批，均为无中生有。

questions.question: Which districts suffer most during a heatwave?
options: A. Districts with the newest housing
B. Districts with the least green space and oldest housing
D. Districts built close to rivers
questions.explanation: excess deaths ... are concentrated in the districts with the least green space and the oldest housing，与题干 suffer most 构成同义替换。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Good morning. This session is about something invisible: sound in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 早上好。这一讲的主题是某种看不见的东西：海洋中的声音。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Most people imagine the sea as a silent place, and that is almost entirely wrong.
sentences.zh: 大多数人把大海想象成一个寂静的地方，而这几乎是完全错误的。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Sound travels through water about four and a half times faster than through air, and it can carry for hundreds of kilometres.
sentences.zh: 声音在水中的传播速度大约是空气中的四点五倍，而且可以传播数百公里。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Marine animals have evolved to exploit this: whales use low-frequency calls that can be heard across entire ocean basins.
sentences.zh: 海洋动物已经进化到能利用这一点：鲸类使用低频叫声，整个洋盆都能听到。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Smaller animals rely on sound differently: many fish use it to find prey, avoid predators and, at night, locate the reef where they were born.
sentences.zh: 较小的动物依赖声音的方式不同：许多鱼类用它寻找猎物、躲避捕食者，并在夜间找到自己出生的礁石。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: For the past century, however, we have been adding noise to that environment on an industrial scale.
sentences.zh: 然而在过去一个世纪里，我们一直在以工业规模向这个环境添加噪音。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: The dominant source is commercial shipping. The global fleet has roughly quadrupled in tonnage since 1950.
sentences.zh: 最主要的来源是商业航运。自 1950 年以来，全球船队的总吨位大约增长到原来的四倍。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Most of the noise comes not from the engines but from the propellers, particularly when a ship is travelling fast or is heavily loaded and the propeller cavitates.
sentences.zh: 大部分噪音并非来自发动机，而是来自螺旋桨，尤其是当船只高速航行或重载、螺旋桨发生空化时。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Because low-frequency sound is absorbed very slowly by water, this noise now forms a permanent background hum across most of the northern hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 由于低频声音在水中被吸收得非常慢，这种噪音如今在北半球大部分海域形成了一种持续的背景嗡鸣。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: A second source is seismic surveying, used by the oil and gas industry, which fires compressed air into the seabed for weeks at a time.
sentences.zh: 第二个来源是石油和天然气行业使用的地震勘探，它会连续数周向海床发射压缩空气。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: A third is naval sonar, which has been linked to mass strandings of whales in several well-documented cases.
sentences.zh: 第三个是海军声呐，在若干有充分记录的案例中，它与鲸类大规模搁浅有关。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: The effects on animals fall into three categories. The most obvious is physical damage to the ears, which is rare but does occur close to very loud sources.
sentences.zh: 对动物的影响分为三类。最明显的是对耳朵的物理损伤，这种情况少见，但在极响的声源附近确实会发生。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: The second is what researchers call masking: the background noise makes it harder for an animal to hear the sounds it actually needs.
sentences.zh: 第二种是研究者所说的掩蔽效应：背景噪音让动物更难听到它真正需要的声音。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: The third, and in some ways the most interesting, is behavioural change. Whales have been recorded altering their calls, either by raising their pitch or simply by calling less, when ships pass.
sentences.zh: 第三种、在某种意义上也最有趣的是行为改变。有记录显示，船只经过时鲸类会改变叫声，要么提高音调，要么干脆少叫。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: That may sound like a trivial adjustment, but if an animal spends more energy finding food or attracting a mate, the cost eventually shows up in the population.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是微不足道的调整，但如果动物要花更多精力寻找食物或吸引配偶，代价最终会反映在种群数量上。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Solutions exist and are mostly cheap. Slowing ships by ten per cent can cut radiated noise by around forty per cent, and it also reduces fuel use and emissions.
sentences.zh: 解决办法是有的，而且大多成本很低。把船速降低百分之十，可使辐射噪音减少约百分之四十，同时还能降低油耗和排放。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: Quieter propeller designs are already available; the obstacle is not technology but the absence of any regulation that rewards them.
sentences.zh: 更安静的螺旋桨设计已经存在；障碍不在技术，而在于没有任何奖励这些设计的法规。

sentences.speaker: Lecturer
sentences.en: So this is a rare environmental problem where the main barrier is political rather than scientific.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个少见的环境问题：主要障碍是政治性的，而非科学性的。

questions.question: What is the lecture mainly about?
options: A. How marine animals communicate with each other
B. Noise created by human activity in the oceans
C. The declining population of large whales
D. New designs for commercial ships
questions.explanation: 开场句 sound in the ocean，随后转折句 we have been adding noise to that environment on an industrial scale 定下主题。A 项只是开头的背景铺垫，不是主旨。

questions.question: What is the main source of noise from ships?
options: C. The hull moving through water
questions.explanation: Most of the noise comes not from the engines but from the propellers。not ... but ... 结构中，but 之后才是答案，这是听力中最经典的反向设置。

questions.question: What does masking mean?
options: A. Animals hide from ships by staying silent
B. Background noise makes useful sounds harder to hear
C. Loud sounds permanently damage animals' ears
D. Animals change the pitch of their calls
questions.explanation: the background noise makes it harder for an animal to hear the sounds it actually needs。C 是第一种影响（物理损伤），D 是第三种影响（行为改变），三项并列极易混淆。

questions.question: What have whales been observed doing when ships pass?
options: A. Moving to quieter coastal waters
C. Changing or reducing their calls
questions.explanation: Whales have been recorded altering their calls, either by raising their pitch or simply by calling less。altering 与题干 changing 对应，or calling less 与 reducing 对应。

questions.question: According to the speaker, what is the main barrier to reducing ocean noise?
options: A. The technology does not yet exist
B. The measures would be too expensive
C. There is no regulation to encourage quieter ships
D. Scientists disagree about the effects
questions.explanation: the obstacle is not technology but the absence of any regulation that rewards them，结尾再次强调 the main barrier is political rather than scientific。A 项与原文直接矛盾。
